svg.metadata: {"revision": 1, "concept_id": "edu.on-versus-above-support", "source_contract": "planning/tactile-masters/source-contract.json", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "design": "Equal rectangular blocks and equal support lines. Upper contact segment intentionally shared; lower block separated above support. Side-view convention after actual-object and teacher-held noncontact preparation. Not activation-on, all-on senses, floating physical object or relief-height measurement.", "geometry_exception": "Index explicitly samples line/area geometry into graphics dots; compatible continuous geometry is shared by swell and ViewPlus.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Single-height dot placement preserves line extent or area/rim extent; no gray encoding and no generic Braille-cell art.
